mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_selection (student_id, course_id, semester, year, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{semester}, #{year}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_selection SET student_id = #{studentId}, course_id = #{courseId}, semester = #{semester}, year = #{year}, status = #{status} WHERE selection_id = #{selectionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_selection WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, selection_id DESC
SELECT * FROM course_selection WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE course_selection SET status = 0 WHERE selection_id = #{selectionId} AND status = 1
UPDATE course_selection SET status = 1 WHERE selection_id = #{selectionId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT cs.selection_id, cs.student_id, cs.course_id, cs.semester, cs.year, cs.status, cs.create_time, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credits, c.hours, c.dept_id, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.status AS course_status, su.real_name AS teacher_name FROM course_selection cs JOIN course c ON c.course_id = cs.course_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = t.user_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY cs.create_time DESC, cs.selection_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = #{status}
